snippet.title: Surviving Mars Relaunched - Feeding the Future | Release Date Announcement
snippet.description:
Prepare your plates; Feeding the Future, the first DLC for Surviving Mars: Relaunched, is served September 8th! 

Your colonists are hungry for more than survival. Feeding the Future expands the food and production systems of Surviving Mars: Relaunched, introducing deeper management, new ingredients, and meals that affect your colonists' comfort and Sanity. Master the art of feeding a colony and face the challenges of life on Mars

Wishlist now: https://www.paradoxinteractive.com/games/surviving-mars-relaunched/add-ons/surviving-mars-relaunched-feeding-the-future
